slices.title: SPA admin section and composer reconcile
slices.summary: Adds the org admin Model access settings section (cloned from OrgQuotasSection, shown when the BFF reports enabled), a catalogue call returning models plus entitlement, and picker and composer reconciliation that resets a stale selection with a notice and caps effort at max_effort, with refusal copy in the i18n errors module. Section visibility follows the BFF flag, never a VITE_ flag.

slices.title: Memory state and the single decision gate
slices.summary: Adds per-user memory state (on, paused, off) and one decision gate, memory_control::resolve, that every memory writer and reader consults under the same row lock, with content-free state events and the GetMemoryControls and SetMemoryControls RPCs. The default 'on' is behaviour-neutral.

slices.title: inference-core: image parts, vision filter, per-model flag (code half)
slices.summary: Adds the additive InferRequest.image_parts (tag 20, InferImagePart with message_index, data and mime_type, bytes only) and maps the indexed images into the OpenAI and Anthropic message bodies. Requests with image parts fail closed with typed vision_unsupported when no vision-capable provider serves the model, and a per-model vision flag with a denylist is advertised in list_models.
